# Summarize October peak vs my past catches
import pandas as pd

trips = tables['trips']
s6_trips = trips[(trips['fish_date_season'] == 6)]

# Group by doy to see average performance
oct_peak = s6_trips[(s6_trips['fish_date_doy'] >= 250) & (s6_trips['fish_date_doy'] <= 274)]

# Calculate by class
by_class = oct_peak.groupby('cls').agg({
    'yt': ['count', 'mean', 'sum'],
    'anglers': ['mean', 'sum']
}).round(2)

by_class['yt_per_angler'] = (by_class['yt']['sum'] / by_class['anglers']['sum']).round(3)

print("October Peak Performance (doy 250-274):")
print(by_class)
